title: Manager x client-type AUM matrix, by region (IPE Top 500, self-reported)
generated_note: Independent of Atlas's own S&P owner/manager data. Each manager self-reports, to IPE Top 500 (2026), how their externally-managed institutional AUM breaks down by client type, in two regional cuts only: "All Institutional Clients" (worldwide) and "European Institutional Clients" (Europe-domiciled clients only). IPE does not publish any finer regional split (e.g. Americas, APAC) or any country-level breakdown of client-type AUM -- Global and Europe are the only two cuts this dataset supports. Converted from EUR to USD at 1.15. A blank cell means the manager didn't disclose that category for that region, not that it's zero -- "Total" sums only the disclosed categories, so it understates the true total wherever a category is missing. Do not treat blanks as zero when aggregating down a column for a market-share style total.
